fact: Burundi carried out its combined population, housing, agriculture and livestock census (RGPHAE) in 2024, run entirely in digital mode.

INSBU's results pages state the RGPHAE 2024 census was carried out in 2024, counting 12,332,788 residents by exhaustive enumeration; the results shown are preliminary, published under decree 100/032 of 27 March 2025.

Decree 100/032 of 27 March 2025 publishes preliminary results of the RGPHAE 2024 census, counting 12,332,788 residents and 2,724,457 ordinary households, pending definitive results; the decree gives no enumeration date, so the census edition year is used.

The UN Demographic Yearbook metadata, completed by the Bureau Central du Recensement, states a full census (RGPHAE 2024) was carried out in 2024 with all administrative entities enumerated, and that preliminary census results were produced in December 2024; final results are still to come.
